name: heygen-video
description: Use when generating a HeyGen presenter video, personalized video message, talking-head explainer, tutorial, product demo, video pitch, or avatar-led update. Also use when the user says “make a video of me saying...” or provides an avatar identity. If the request also asks to create an avatar, use the avatar skill first. Do not use for avatar setup, translation, TTS-only tasks, cinematic footage without a presenter, or streaming avatars.
